title: Recovery of Meal Charges from Pay
content:
A meal tendered against payroll on an Employee Meal Account is added to the charges awaiting recovery and carries the payroll period it belongs to, so that every charge can be matched to the pay packet that will recover it. **That clause is no longer in force**: what a charge carried to pay comes to, and what the account carries forward, are settled on the current basis for each, and this document does not restate them.

## Where payroll tender is available, and the arrears ceiling

Payroll tender is only available on a plan that enables it, and the charges awaiting recovery may not pass the arrears ceiling printed against the plan; a meal that would take them past it is declined for payroll and met from stored value instead.

## Remittance

A payroll period's charges are remitted the number of days after the period closes printed against the plan, and no more than the deduction ceiling printed against the same plan is recovered in one period; what is left over rolls into the next period. **Of that clause, both the remittance lag and the deduction ceiling are no longer in force** — when a period's charges are remitted, and the ceiling one period's recovery is held to, are now fixed by the current basis for working out a recovery. That what is left over rolls into the next period remains in force.

## The state the account must stand in

A recovery is only posted while the account stands active, restricted, parked for leave or closed, because a leaver's last charges are still recovered from their final pay. The account's own record settles this before the recovery is posted, read by the account's reference together with the charges awaiting recovery and the payroll cycle it is recovered on.

## Leavers, errors and leave

Where an employee leaves with charges still awaiting recovery, the whole outstanding balance is recovered in the final pay period whatever the deduction ceiling says, and where final pay does not cover it, the balance is passed to the employer to collect.

A charge accrued in error is reversed against the same payroll period it was accrued in, never against a later one, so that the employee's payslip and the account agree.

An employee on recorded leave accrues no new charges, because the account is parked and the badge is declined at the till.

## States at a glance

| Account state | A recovery may be posted |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Restricted | Yes |
| Parked for leave | Yes |
| Closed | Yes |
| Enrolled | No |
